title: The Star That 'Screamed' for 28 Years Before Going Dark
hook: For nearly three decades, a star emitted a signal that sounded like a cosmic scream. Then it just stopped.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a star 'screaming' for decades triggers deep unease and curiosity about what made it stop.

title: The Declassified NSA File: 'We Lost a Satellite to a Gravity Anomaly'

why_this_can_go_viral: Declassified government secrets about a satellite that vanished into nothing fuels conspiracy and fear.
